review:
Royal High-Road is a fairy-tale 25-line slot about a hero on a long journey, with forest sounds and gently melancholic music. Its key feature is Gold Respin, with a Royal jackpot worth 5,000x the bet.

Like Gold Rush – Johnny Cash and Grand Mustang, coins trigger a respin round where you aim to fill the grid for the top prize. Bonus buys are available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,624x maximum and a 96.14% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 182 spins. Choose it if you prefer a storybook theme over the western versions.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
